literal: Without planning, by itself completion will happen, their own family (obj.) without slackening to those who strive.
translation: Success will come on its own, even without prior planning, to those who strive tirelessly to uplift their family.
modern: தம் குடியை உயர்த்துவதற்குச் சோர்வில்லாமல் தொடர்ந்து முயற்சி செய்பவர்களுக்கு, அவர்கள் முன்கூட்டியே திட்டமிடாமலேயே வெற்றி தானாகவே வந்து சேரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the power of relentless effort in elevating one's family or lineage. The phrase 'தாழாது உஞற்றுபவர்க்கு' refers to those who strive continuously without any slackening or delay. For such dedicated individuals, the text says that 'முடிவு' (completion or success) will happen 'தானே' (by itself). Even if they proceed 'சூழாமல்' (without extensive deliberation or planning), their sheer persistent effort will naturally bring about the desired successful outcome.
